newsitem.title: UK: NORILSK TO UP COBALT OUTPUT BY 2000 -ANALYST.
newsitem.headline: NORILSK TO UP COBALT OUTPUT BY 2000 -ANALYST.

text.p: Russia's leading cobalt producer, RAO Norilsk Nickel, has drawn up a programme to increase output to around 4,000 tonnes by 2000 from 1,510 tonnes in 1996, a study published by industry analyst Roskill Information Services said.
The report said exports from Russia rose from 1,473 tonnes in 1992 to 2,553 in 1996 owing to higher export prices and lower domestic demand, especially from the defence sector.
"The possible increase in Russian cobalt production in 1997, together with stable domestic consumption, suggests that exports will increase further in 1997," Roskill said.
